correctness.rationale: For char not 2 or 3, the ETF trace equations force a nonzero common norm and normalize every candidate to parameters (1,1/3,2). Unitary normalization and unimodular column phases reduce three vectors to (mu,rho u_j). Pairwise equiangularity is exactly t^2+t+1=0 for phase ratios t in the norm-one torus. Hence necessity is 3|(q+1); the displayed cube-root construction directly verifies sufficiency and tightness. The a=0 case is excluded because it would make the Hermitian form vanish on a spanning set.

value.rationale: This determines an entire natural slice, d=2 away from modular characteristics, of the explicit finite-field Zauner existence problem. It replaces a list of sporadic projected examples by a sharp arithmetic criterion and a normal form, and it identifies the structural obstruction as the absence of 3-torsion in the norm-one torus.
